candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on German subordinating and relative conjunctions used to introduce dependent clauses.
Common German action verbs in various conjugations and inflections.
Common German prepositions and grammatical particles.
This vector is related to German auxiliary, modal, and subjunctive verbs indicating past tense, conditional mood, or possession.
This vector represents German prepositions indicating location, time, or circumstance.
These tokens represent German masculine and neuter genitive or dative singular noun modifiers and articles.
This vector represents common German third-person singular and plural present-tense verb stems.
This vector represents tokens associated with round objects, containers, or words containing the phonetic sound and spelling sequence "ow".
This vector represents German personal pronouns and related closed-class words starting with the letter 's' or 'i'.
This feature vector activates on German umlauts and words containing them.
